notes: Shalya Parva, eighteenth day — Shalya's command and fall, Shakuni's death, Duryodhana's flight to the lake. No gore, no bodies. Kripa, Sahadeva, Shakuni and Kritavarma are narrated only, never drawn. Krishna = Ep 04 lock (official series reference): pale silvery dusty-blue skin, long loose curls, slim gold band with one peacock feather, white U-tilak, jasmine-rose garland, saffron-yellow pitambar dhoti, crimson sash, exactly two hands. Yudhishthira and Bhima = Ep 14/15 locks; Shalya = Ep 16 lock; Duryodhana and Ashwatthama = Ep 16 locks. One new scene master (field18 daylight); camp18 is a byte copy of Ep 16's night camp.

krishna.face: Youthful divine adult, serene dark eyes, gentle half-smile — the official series Krishna is the Ep 04 lock (episodes/04-akshayapatra/stills/_locks/krishna.jpg; Avinash 2026-10-05): pale silvery dusty-blue skin, white U-tilak on the brow
krishna.hair: Long loose dark curls under a slim gold band with one peacock feather (not a tall crown)
krishna.costume: Saffron-yellow pitambar dhoti, crimson sash, jasmine-and-rose flower garland, gold jewelry; exactly two hands; Arjuna's charioteer (reins looped over one wrist), counsellor to Yudhishthira in this episode — never a flute, never a bow, never a child

yudhishthira.face: Eldest Pandava king, calm noble face, modest mustache, dharma in the eyes — distinct from Arjuna (Ep 14/15 lock)
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem (lighter than Arjuna's heavy crown), no peacock feather
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white royal dhoti and cream angavastram, gold sash, gold armlets, bow of the king; the gold-and-gem shakti dart on beats dart/fall — no gold chest armor, no Gandiva, no flower garland

bhima.face: Adult Pandava, broad noble face, full dark mustache, fierce dark eyes — never a child (Ep 14/15 lock)
bhima.hair: Dark hair, gold warrior circlet (not Arjuna's crown, not peacock)
bhima.costume: Deep gold and leaf-green engraved armor, great gold-decked mace — never saffron sage robes

shalya.face: Mature king of Madra: strong weathered face, thick dark mustache and short dark beard streaked with grey, fierce dark eyes (Ep 16 lock) — a warrior-king, never a sage, never fully white-bearded
shalya.hair: Dark hair streaked with grey under a tall silver-and-gold Madra crown
shalya.costume: Deep indigo-blue and silver-gold engraved armor, white-and-silver angavastram, gold armlets; commander now, on his own chariot under the golden-ploughshare banner; mace, sword and round shield in the duels — never saffron sage robes, never flower garland

duryodhana.face: Adult Kaurava king, proud upswept mustache, fierce gaze (Ep 13 lock via Ep 16)
duryodhana.hair: Dark hair under a tall jeweled Kuru crown
duryodhana.costume: Jewel-tone gold Kaurava armor with saffron-orange cape, gold-decked mace — field king, not a sage

ashwatthama.face: Young adult Brahmin-warrior, the guru's son: noble lean face, dark mustache, intense dark eyes; a luminous jewel (mani) in the middle of his forehead (Ep 15 lock via Ep 16); never a child, never white-bearded
ashwatthama.hair: Dark hair tied back under a slim bronze-gold warrior band (no royal crown, no peacock feather)
ashwatthama.costume: Deep maroon and bronze-gold engraved armor, white sacred thread across the chest, cream dhoti, great bow — no saffron sage robes, no flower garland

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore, no bodies
